title: Accounting: Payment

id.description: Identifier for the payment, unique to the company in the accounting software.

customerRef.description: Customer the payment is recorded against in the accounting software.

accountRef.description: Account the payment is recorded against in the accounting software.

paymentMethodRef.description: The Payment Method to which the payment is linked in the accounting software.

totalAmount.description: Amount of the payment in the payment currency. This value should never change and represents the amount of money paid into the customer's account.

currency.description: ISO currency code recorded for the payment in the accounting software.

date.description: Date the payment was recorded in the accounting software.

note.description: Any additional information associated with the payment.

allocatedOnDate.description: The date the payment was allocated.

id.description: Unique identifier of the transaction represented by the link.

amount.description:
Amount by which the balance of the linked entity is altered, in the currency of the linked entity.  
A negative link amount _reduces_ the outstanding amount on the accounts receivable account.  
A positive link amount _increases_ the outstanding amount on the accounts receivable account.

paymentLinkType.title: Payment Link Type
paymentLinkType.description:
Types of payment line links, either:  
`Unknown`  
`Unlinked` - Not used  
`Invoice` - ID refers to the invoice  
`CreditNote` - ID refers to the credit note  
`Refund` - ID refers to the sibling payment  
`Payment` - ID refers to the sibling payment  
`PaymentOnAccount` - ID refers to the customer  
`Other` - ID refers to the customer  
`Manual Journal`  
`Discount` - ID refers to the payment
